conclusion.minimal_correction: Use separate statically typed Fixed/Variadic forms; for runtime metadata only use types.GenericAlias(origin, args), or retain a custom alias with an explicit static-checking limitation.
conclusion.not_tested: Pyright claims, because Pyright is absent.
